info.title: Cider.Server — Local /v1/systemone HTTP Server Tool
info.description: Drop-in Jev-compatible POST /v1/systemone and /v1/classifier HTTP decision server tool powered by Cider.NET and Cider.Native.

commands.name: calibrate
commands.description:
Fit per-question calibration parameters from a labeled JSONL dataset
and write a versioned JSON calibration profile (run 'cider-server calibrate --help')

options.name: --dataset
options.description: Path to labeled JSONL dataset

options.name: --output
options.description: Output path for versioned JSON calibration file (alias: -o)

options.name: --backend
options.description: llamacpp | deterministic | managed | ollama (default: llamacpp if --gguf, else deterministic)

options.name: --gguf
options.description: GGUF file path or Ollama model tag for llamacpp/managed

options.name: --model
options.description: Model identifier recorded in calibration profile

options.name: --ollama-url
options.description: Ollama base URL when --backend ollama (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434)

options.name: --model-hash
options.description: Optional 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex model hash (for backends without IModelIdentityProvider)

options.name: --explicit-config
options.description: Require explicit --backend, --model, absolute paths, and disable ambient env vars

options.name: --policy
options.description: v1 | state-first-v1 | tev1 | decider (default: v1)

options.name: --layout
options.description: auto | chatml | llama3 | gemma | phi3 | mistral (default: auto)

options.name: --noul-strategy
options.description: binary | rating_1_to_9 (default: binary)

options.name: --permutations
options.description: Option permutations during calibration (1..255; default: 1)

options.name: --target-selective-accuracy
options.description: Target selective accuracy in (0, 1] for suggested threshold (default: 0.90)

options.name: --min-selective-coverage
options.description: Minimum selective coverage in [0, 1] for suggested threshold (default: 0.0)

options.name: --fit-label-biases
options.description: Also estimate zero-mean per-label prior biases for Choice/Score questions

options.name: --no-noul-bias
options.description: Fit 1-parameter temperature only for binary Noul (disable Platt bias)

options.name: --min-temperature
options.description: Minimum temperature search bound (default: 0.05)

options.name: --max-temperature
options.description: Maximum temperature search bound (default: 5.0)

options.name: --fence-nonce
options.description:
process | auto | none | <token> (default: per-run random 64-bit hex)
llama.cpp & budgeting options:

options.name: --gpu-layers
options.description: GPU layers to offload (-1 = all, 0 = CPU only; default: -1)

options.name: --llama-backend
options.description: auto | cpu | vulkan | cuda | metal (default: auto)

options.name: --llama-device
options.description: Comma-separated ggml device names

options.name: --llama-backend-path
options.description: Explicit path to an external ggml backend module or directory (repeatable)

options.name: --require-gpu
options.description: Fail instead of falling back to CPU

options.name: --threads
options.description: CPU threads per context for decoding

options.name: --threads-batch
options.description: CPU threads per context for batch evaluation

options.name: --context-size
options.description: Context window token budget (alias: --n-ctx)

options.name: --state-truncation
options.description: reject | middle | head | tail (default: reject)

options.name: --state-truncation-head-ratio
options.description: Fraction of state kept at head under middle truncation (default: 0.5)

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message and exit

options.name: --port
options.description: HTTP port to listen on over 127.0.0.1 (default: 8080)

options.name: --socket
options.description:
Listen on a user-only Unix domain socket (Linux/macOS, 0600) or
current-user Windows named pipe instead of TCP loopback

options.name: --model
options.description: Served model identifier (default: jev-1.13.0)

options.name: --backend
options.description: Backend: ollama | llamacpp | managed | systemone | deterministic (default: ollama)

options.name: --ollama-url
options.description: Ollama base URL (default: http://127.0.0.1:11434)

options.name: --upstream-url
options.description: Upstream /v1/systemone URL when --backend systemone

options.name: --gguf
options.description: GGUF file path or Ollama model tag for llamacpp/managed

options.name: --embedding-gguf
options.description:
Optional dedicated GGUF path or Ollama tag for POST /v1/embeddings
(when omitted, /v1/embeddings uses the active backend if supported)

options.name: --embedding-model
options.description:
Optional served model ID for POST /v1/embeddings when --embedding-gguf is set
(defaults to --model; advertised in GET /v1/models when distinct)

options.name: --embedding-context-size
options.description: Context window in tokens for --embedding-gguf (default: --context-size or 2048)

options.name: --explicit-config
options.description:
Disable all ambient env vars (CIDER_API_KEY, CIDER_LLAMA_*, GGML_BACKEND_PATH,
OLLAMA_MODELS), require explicit absolute --gguf or --ollama-url/--upstream-url,
require explicit --backend and --model, and disable silent GPU-to-CPU fallback

options.name: --max-inflight
options.description: Maximum concurrent HTTP requests (default: 8)

options.name: --request-timeout-ms
options.description: Default per-request timeout in ms (default: 0, disabled)

options.name: --api-key-file
options.description: Read Bearer API key from a file (trims trailing CR/LF)

options.name: --api-key-stdin
options.description: Read Bearer API key as a single line from stdin

options.name: --api-key
options.description:
(Deprecated: visible in argv) Optional Bearer API key
Fallback env var: CIDER_API_KEY

options.name: --enforce-model-id
options.description: Reject requests whose model field does not match --model

options.name: --self-test
options.description: Run built-in smoke test and exit

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message and exit
llama.cpp backend options:

options.name: --gpu-layers
options.description: GPU layers to offload (-1 = all, 0 = CPU only; default: -1)

options.name: --llama-backend
options.description: auto | cpu | vulkan | cuda | metal (default: auto)

options.name: --llama-device
options.description: Comma-separated ggml device names (e.g. Vulkan1)

options.name: --llama-backend-path
options.description:
Explicit path to an external ggml backend module or directory
(repeatable; e.g. /path/to/libggml-cuda.so from llama.cpp b12110)

options.name: --require-gpu
options.description: Fail instead of falling back to CPU

options.name: --list-devices
options.description: Print registered ggml backends/devices and exit

options.name: --context-pool-size
options.description: Independent llama_context slots sharing one model (alias: --concurrency; default: 1)

options.name: --threads
options.description: CPU threads per context for decoding/generation (llama.cpp n_threads; >= 1)

options.name: --threads-batch
options.description:
CPU threads per context for prompt/batch processing (llama.cpp n_threads_batch; >= 1)
Prompt, cache, and budgeting options:

options.name: --policy
options.description: v1 | state-first-v1 | tev1 | decider (default: v1)

options.name: --layout
options.description:
Prompt layout (alias: --prompt-layout): auto | chatml | llama3 |
gemma | phi3 | mistral (default: auto — detected from GGUF metadata)

options.name: --fence-nonce
options.description: process | auto | none | <token> (default: per-process random 64-bit hex)

options.name: --no-prefix-cache
options.description: Disable cross-request prefix state reuse

options.name: --prefix-cache-entries
options.description: Max hybrid/recurrent prefix snapshots (0 disables)

options.name: --prefix-cache-max-mb
options.description: Max hybrid/recurrent prefix cache size in MiB (0 disables)

options.name: --context-size
options.description: Context window token budget (alias: --n-ctx; default: 8192 for llamacpp)

options.name: --state-truncation
options.description: reject | middle | head | tail (default: reject)

options.name: --state-truncation-head-ratio
options.description: Fraction of state kept at head under middle truncation (0..1; default: 0.5)

options.name: --calibration-file
options.description: Versioned JSON calibration profile to validate at startup and apply per question_id

options.name: --model-hash
options.description:
Explicit 64-char lowercase SHA-256 hex model hash for --calibration-file verification
(required for backends without IModelIdentityProvider; verified against backend if supported)

options.name: --require-all-calibrated
options.description: Reject requests containing any question_id absent from --calibration-file
